---
title: "Q3"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=TRUE}
# Global options to ensure code and results are visible
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

# Input Data
x1 <- c(3, 5, 6, 8, 12, 14)
x2 <- c(16, 10, 7, 4, 3, 2)
x3 <- c(90, 72, 54, 42, 30, 12)
df1 <- data.frame(x1, x2, x3)

# a. Least-squares regression equation
model1 <- lm(x3 ~ x1 + x2, data = df1)
intercept <- coef(model1)[1]
b1 <- coef(model1)[2]
b2 <- coef(model1)[3]

cat("a. Regression Equation:\n")
cat(paste0("X3 = ", round(intercept, 2), " + (", round(b1, 2), ")X1 + (", round(b2, 2), ")X2\n\n"))

# b. Estimate X3 when X1 = 10 and X2 = 6
new_data <- data.frame(x1 = 10, x2 = 6)
prediction <- predict(model1, newdata = new_data)

cat("b. Prediction:\n")
cat("For X1 = 10 and X2 = 6, estimated X3 is:", round(prediction, 2), "\n")

# Residual standard error represents the standard error of estimate
se_estimate <- summary(model1)$sigma

cat("Standard Error of Estimate (S_x3.12):", round(se_estimate, 2), "\n")

# R is the square root of R-squared
r_squared <- summary(model1)$r.squared
R_multiple <- sqrt(r_squared)

cat("Coefficient of Multiple Determination (R^2):", round(r_squared, 4), "\n")
cat("Coefficient of Multiple Correlation (R):", round(R_multiple, 4), "\n")

# Using the formula for partial correlation or the 'ppcor' logic manually
# r12.3 = (r12 - r13*r23) / sqrt((1-r13^2)(1-r23^2))
r12 <- cor(x1, x2)
r13 <- cor(x1, x3)
r23 <- cor(x2, x3)

r12_3 <- (r12 - (r13 * r23)) / sqrt((1 - r13^2) * (1 - r23^2))

cat("Partial Correlation Coefficient (r12.3):", round(r12_3, 4), "\n")

# Housing Data
price <- c(165, 200, 225, 180, 202, 250, 275, 300, 155, 230)
bedrooms <- c(3, 3, 4, 2, 4, 4, 3, 5, 2, 4)
baths <- c(2, 3, 3, 3, 2, 4, 4, 3, 2, 4)
df_house <- data.frame(price, bedrooms, baths)

# a. Regression model
model_house <- lm(price ~ bedrooms + baths, data = df_house)
cat("a. Housing Regression Model:\n")
print(summary(model_house)$coefficients)

# b. Estimate price for 5 bedrooms and 4 baths
new_house <- data.frame(bedrooms = 5, baths = 4)
pred_house <- predict(model_house, newdata = new_house)

cat("\nb. Estimation:\n")
cat("The estimated price for a house with 5 bedrooms and 4 baths is:", round(pred_house, 2), "\n")
